title: Model Performance Degradation Runbook
description: Steps for diagnosing and remediating model performance degradation.
steps: 1. Collect model performance metrics for the current window.
2. Compare against historical metrics to establish degradation magnitude.
3. Check whether data drift is present (co-occurring drift often causes degradation).
4. Check for recent deployment events or dataset changes.
5. If drift co-occurs: treat as DATA_DRIFT incident, proceed to retraining.
6. If no drift: investigate data quality and pipeline issues.
7. If retraining is warranted: submit RETRAIN_MODEL through policy engine.
9. Deploy via canary if gates pass.
success_criteria: F1 >= threshold for 3 consecutive monitoring windows.
escalation: Escalate if F1 does not recover after retraining.
